title: AgentWall：本地AI代理的运行时安全层
summary: AgentWall 是一个针对本地AI代理的运行时安全与可观测层。它在代理动作执行前进行拦截，依据声明式策略评估，对敏感操作要求人工审批，并记录完整执行轨迹。作为MCP代理和OpenClaw插件实现，支持Claude Desktop、Cursor等工具，策略执行准确率92.9%，开销亚毫秒级。开源。
summary_en: AgentWall is a runtime safety and observability layer for local AI agents. It intercepts every proposed agent action before execution, evaluates against declarative policies, requires human approval for sensitive operations, and records a full audit trail. Implemented as an MCP proxy and OpenClaw plugin, it achieves 92.9% policy enforcement accuracy with sub-millisecond overhead. Open-source.
